paragraphs.en: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast , a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player’s position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another’s generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast’s consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 多人世界模型必须生成可独立控制的视角，并对所有玩家及其共享环境保持一致的表示。 大多数现有方法通过联合多视角生成来协调多个玩家，其成本会随着每个新增玩家而增加。 我们提出了 WorldCast，一种分布式多人世界模型，其中每个玩家运行一个本地客户端，包含视频生成器和状态模型。 训练期间，状态模型利用记录的玩家位置和地图几何信息，从生成的视频和控制输入中估算玩家的位置。 客户端交换玩家状态，并将其投影到与摄像头对齐的玩家状态场中，以指导其他玩家的渲染位置与方式。 共享场景状态使客户端能够复用彼此生成的观察结果，从而在不同视角间保持场景外观的一致性。 在《反恐精英 2》上的实验证明了 WorldCast 的一致性、实时性能和分布式可扩展性。 与联合生成方法相比，与摄像头对齐的玩家状态场将玩家渲染速率提升了超过一个数量级，而共享场景状态则在整个回合中提升了视觉一致性。 每个客户端都以实时运行，且仅交换玩家和场景状态，从而实现可扩展的多人生成，无需集中式计算瓶颈。 图像质量在长达一小时的连续运行过程中保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Interactive video world models generate an agent’s visual observations in response to its actions ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025b ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . Multiplayer world modeling extends this setting to several independently controlled players in a shared environment ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ) . When players are visible, their locations should be consistent across viewpoints; previously observed parts of the environment should also retain their appearance across views and over time. Each view should remain responsive as players are added and, ideally, be generated on its own machine. Maintaining cross-view consistency without coupling the computation of different views is the central challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频世界模型会根据智能体的行为生成其视觉观察结果（Bruce 等，2024；He 等，2025b；Valevski 等，2025；Huang 等，2026a）。 多人世界建模将这一设定扩展到共享环境中的多个独立控制的玩家（Cai 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Savva 等，2026）。 当玩家可见时，他们的位置应在不同视角中保持一致；环境中先前观察到的部分在不同视角以及随时间推移也应保持其外观不变。 随着玩家的加入，每个视角都应保持响应能力，并且理想情况下应能在其自身的机器上生成。 在不耦合不同视角计算的前提下维持跨视角一致性是核心挑战。

paragraphs.en: Most prior methods generate players’ views jointly through cross-view attention ( Hu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ) , increasing computation and inter-device communication as players are added. Generating views independently avoids this coupling, but each generator then has access only to its own observations and controls. It needs additional information to place other players correctly and reproduce scene content observed from other viewpoints. A distributed approach must therefore share both spatial information about players and generated scene appearance, without requiring the views to be generated together.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数先前的方法通过跨视角注意力机制联合生成玩家的视角（Hu et al., 2026a; Hu et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026; Mo et al., 2026; Savva et al., 2026; Sun et al., 2026a），但随着玩家数量的增加，计算量和设备间通信量也会随之增大。 独立生成视角可以避免这种耦合，但这样一来，每个生成器就只能访问自身的观察结果和控制信息。 为了正确定位其他玩家并重现从其他视角观察到的场景内容，这种方法还需要额外的信息。 因此，分布式方法必须共享关于玩家的空間信息以及生成的场景外观，而无需将这些视角一同生成。

paragraphs.en: To provide this shared information while keeping generation independent, we propose WorldCast . Inspired by the organization of networked games ( Funkhouser, 1995 ; Bernier, 2001 ) , each player runs a client that maintains a local copy of the shared world state and generates its own view. We represent this state with two complementary components. Player state records players’ positions and attributes, projected into a camera-aligned player state field that guides the rendering of other players. Scene state stores generated observations in a shared memory bank, supplying content missing from each client’s recent context. Clients exchange these states once per video block while keeping intermediate features local. A fixed-resolution player state field and a bounded number of retrieved scene frames allow additional players without enlarging the generator’s input.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在保持生成独立性的同时提供这种共享信息，我们提出了 WorldCast。 受网络游戏组织方式的启发（Funkhouser, 1995；Bernier, 2001），每位玩家运行一个客户端，该客户端维护共享世界状态的本地副本并生成自己的视图。 我们用两个互补的组件来表示这种状态。 玩家状态记录了玩家的位置和属性，并将其投影到与摄像头对齐的玩家状态字段中，以指导对其他玩家的渲染。 场景状态将生成的观察结果存储在共享内存库中，为每个客户端最近的上下文提供缺失的内容。 客户端在每个视频块中交换一次这些状态，同时保持中间特征在本地。 固定分辨率的玩家状态字段和有限数量的检索场景帧使得无需扩大生成器的输入即可添加更多玩家。

paragraphs.en: Unlike in a networked game, WorldCast has no engine supplying positions and geometry at inference. Each client therefore includes a state model , trained with recorded positions and map geometry, that estimates its own position and scene depth from generated video and controls. Position estimates correct control-based extrapolation and update player state; depth supports player visibility checks and scene memory retrieval. After each block, clients publish these updates and share the generated observations, completing the loop between generation and state estimation.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate WorldCast on Counter-Strike 2 (Fig. 1 ). Given the same ground-truth (GT) player positions, our camera-aligned player field achieves a player rendering rate over ten times that of the joint-generation ( Savva et al., 2026 ) and frame-concatenation baselines. This rate measures the proportion of visible players rendered at their expected positions. Predicted player positions retain much of this rendering rate over ten-second windows (Table 2 ). Shared scene state further improves visual consistency over whole rounds (Table 3 ). With scene state enabled, each client generates video at over 16 FPS across deployments of 2 to 16 clients (Fig. 6 ), including decoding but excluding synchronization waits. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在《反恐精英 2》（图 1）上对 WorldCast 进行了评估。 在给定相同的真实玩家位置（GT）时，我们的相机对齐玩家场实现的玩家渲染率是联合生成（Savva 等人，2026）和帧拼接基线方法的十倍以上。 该比率衡量的是可见玩家在其预期位置处被渲染的比例。 在十秒的时间窗口内，预测的玩家位置仍能保持这一渲染率的很大一部分（表 2）。 共享场景状态进一步提升了整轮游戏中的视觉一致性（表 3）。 启用场景状态后，在每个部署中（从 2 到 16 个客户端），每个客户端都能以超过 16 FPS 的帧率生成视频（图 6），该速率已包含解码时间，但不包括同步等待时间。 图像质量在持续一小时的运行过程中保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose WorldCast , a distributed multiplayer world model whose clients each generate one player’s view and share only a world state, which conditions each generator through a camera-aligned player state field and a scene memory bank.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldCast，这是一种分布式多人世界模型。其每个客户端都会生成一名玩家的视角，并且仅共享世界状态；该状态通过一个与摄像头对齐的玩家状态字段和一个场景记忆库来对每个生成器进行条件约束。

paragraphs.en: We develop a state model that estimates each player’s position and scene depth from its generated video and controls, enabling clients to update the shared world state without a game engine supplying these quantities at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种状态模型，该模型能够从智能体生成的视频和控制信息中估算每个玩家的位置和场景深度，从而使得客户端无需依赖游戏引擎在推理阶段提供这些量值，即可更新共享的世界状态。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate improved player rendering and whole-round visual consistency on Counter-Strike 2. Each client generates video in real time with 2 to 16 players, and image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在《反恐精英 2》中展示了更出色的玩家渲染效果和整局游戏内的视觉一致性。 每个客户端都能实时生成包含 2 到 16 名玩家的视频，且图像质量在持续一小时的运行过程中保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Multiplayer World Models. Extending single-view world models ( He et al., 2025b ; Kanervisto et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , joint-generation methods denoise all views together ( Hu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , so views on different machines exchange attention features at every step (Appendix B ); shared-screen methods bind each agent’s actions to its character in one frame ( Pondaven et al., 2026 ) ; shared-state methods condition views on a state advanced by actions, either centrally ( Cai et al., 2026 ) or by per-player generators on a given map ( Po et al., 2026 ) , or encoded from all views’ latest frames ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . WorldCast clients exchange only player state, estimated from generated video and controls, and scene state, a memory bank of generated blocks.

paragraphs.en: Controllable Video Generation. Structured conditioning provides spatial guidance for image and video generation. Object boxes can be encoded as additional tokens ( Li et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Russell et al., 2025 ) , while image-aligned control maps convey edges or depth ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , motion trajectories ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) or time-varying 3D states ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Diffusion. Autoregressive video diffusion models generate video incrementally in a video autoencoder’s latent space ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) with block-causal attention ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025b ) trains on the model’s own rollouts to reduce error accumulation, and LIVE ( Huang et al., 2026b ) bounds this error to keep rollouts stable well beyond the training horizon. Distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) enables few-step generators. To preserve scenes beyond a limited context window, memory-augmented models ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026b ) retrieve their own past frames by field-of-view overlap, camera pose or 3D geometry. ShareVerse ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) also retrieves other agents’ frames by proximity within joint denoising. WorldCast combines four-step autoregressive generation with a memory bank shared across independent clients, allowing clients to reuse one another’s generated content without jointly denoising their views.

paragraphs.en: WorldCast lets multiple players inhabit one generated world, kept consistent through a shared world state. This state comprises player state, which describes players’ positions and attributes, and scene state, which stores generated observations of the environment. We first introduce the distributed generation framework (Sec. 3.1 ), then describe how player state (Sec. 3.2 ) and scene state (Sec. 3.3 ) are maintained and incorporated into each generator. We next present the state model that estimates position and depth from generated video (Sec. 3.4 ), followed by training and inference (Sec. 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: WorldCast 让多名玩家共同存在于一个生成的世界中，并通过共享的世界状态保持其一致性。 该状态包括玩家状态（描述玩家的位置和属性）以及场景状态（存储对环境生成的观察结果）。 我们首先介绍分布式生成框架（第 3.1 节），然后描述玩家状态（第 3.2 节）和场景状态（第 3.3 节）如何被维护并整合到每个生成器中。 接下来，我们介绍用于从生成的视频中估计位置和深度的状态模型（第 3.4 节），随后是训练与推理部分（第 3.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: To support scalable multiplayer video generation across machines, WorldCast separates shared world state from local rendering. As in Fig. 2 (a), existing coupled designs coordinate players through joint multi-view generation that processes players’ views together through cross-view attention or view concatenation. WorldCast instead assigns each of the P P players an independent client that reads shared world state, generates its own view, and publishes updated state once per block (Fig. 2 (b)). Each client runs on its own GPU and combines a video generator G θ G_{\theta} with a state model that estimates position and scene depth from generated video and controls. Only the shared world state is exchanged; activations, KV caches, and intermediate features remain local.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持跨机器的可扩展多人视频生成，WorldCast 将共享世界状态与本地渲染分离。 如图 2 (a) 所示，现有的耦合设计通过联合多视角生成来协调玩家，该生成过程通过跨视角注意力或视角拼接共同处理玩家的视角。 相比之下，WorldCast 为 P 名玩家中的每一位分配一个独立的客户端，该客户端读取共享世界状态、生成自己的视角，并在每个区块中发布一次更新后的状态（图 2 (b)）。 每个客户端都在其自身的 GPU 上运行，并将视频生成器 G θ G_{\theta} 与一个状态模型相结合，该状态模型根据生成的视频和控制信息来估计位置和场景深度。 只有共享世界状态会被交换；激活值、KV 缓存和中间特征则保留在本地。

The shared world state therefore comprises two complementary components: player state , a record of each player’s position and attributes (Sec. 3.2 ), and scene state , a memory bank shared by all clients (Sec. 3.3 ). Together, these shared states help clients render players and scene appearance consistently across independently generated views.

paragraphs.en: Camera-aligned player state field. Player states are expressed in world coordinates, whereas the generator operates on image tokens. The state injector bridges these representations by projecting other players into the observing client’s camera and encoding their attributes at the corresponding token locations. Specifically, for each latent frame f f , it constructs a player state field 𝐅 n , f i \mathbf{F}_{n,f}^{i} on the generator’s token grid. Each player within the view frustum and visible (Sec. 3.4 ) is projected into the observer’s camera and splatted with a Gaussian kernel ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The field encodes coverage, camera-relative depth and facing direction, and gameplay attributes such as team, identity, weapon, and controls. Contributions from overlapping players are combined according to their spatial weights and depths (Appendix F ). This gives the generator explicit spatial guidance about where other players should appear and which attributes to render.

paragraphs.en: Scene memory retrieval. Before generating block n n , client i i retrieves the memory entry 𝐌 n i \mathbf{M}_{n}^{i} that best covers scene content missing from its recent context. It first back-projects the recent latent frames into 3D and projects these points into the cameras of the upcoming block. Pixels reached by none of these points are treated as missing. The client then projects the points of all memory entries into the same cameras. At each missing pixel, the nearest projected point to the camera defines the reference surface depth. An entry covers that pixel if one of its points lies within a depth tolerance of this surface, preventing occluded content from contributing to its coverage score. The client retrieves the entry covering the most missing pixels, or none if no entry covers any.
paragraphs.zh: 场景记忆检索。 在生成第 n 个块之前，客户端 i 会检索最能覆盖其近期上下文中缺失的场景内容的记忆条目 𝐌 n i \mathbf{M}_{n}^{i}。 它首先将近期的潜在帧反向投影为三维，并将这些点投影到即将处理的块中的摄像头中。 没有任何一个点能到达的像素被视为缺失。 随后，客户端将所有记忆条目中的点投影到相同的摄像头中。 在每个缺失的像素处，距离摄像头最近的投影点定义了参考表面的深度。 如果某个记忆条目的点之一位于该表面深度容限范围内，则视为覆盖了该像素，从而防止被遮挡的内容计入其覆盖分数。 客户端会检索覆盖最多缺失像素的记忆条目；如果没有条目覆盖任何缺失像素，则不检索。

paragraphs.en: The shared player and scene states require positions and geometry that correspond to the generated world. At inference, these quantities are not supplied by a game engine. Each client therefore uses a state model to estimate its own position and scene depth from generated latents and controls (Fig. 3 , right). Position estimates update the shared player state, while depth estimates support scene memory retrieval and player visibility.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的玩家和场景状态需要与生成的世界相对应的位置和几何信息。 在推理阶段，这些量并非由游戏引擎提供。 因此，每个客户端都使用一个状态模型，根据生成的潜在变量和控制参数来估计自身位置和场景深度（图 3，右侧）。 位置估计会更新共享的玩家状态，而深度估计则支持场景记忆的检索和玩家可见性判断。

sents.en: The shared player and scene states require positions and geometry that correspond to the generated world.
sents.zh: 共享的玩家和场景状态需要与生成的世界相对应的位置和几何信息。

sents.en: At inference, these quantities are not supplied by a game engine.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，这些量并非由游戏引擎提供。

sents.en: Each client therefore uses a state model to estimate its own position and scene depth from generated latents and controls (Fig. 3 , right).
sents.zh: 因此，每个客户端都使用一个状态模型，根据生成的潜在变量和控制参数来估计自身位置和场景深度（图 3，右侧）。

sents.en: Position estimates update the shared player state, while depth estimates support scene memory retrieval and player visibility.
sents.zh: 位置估计会更新共享的玩家状态，而深度估计则支持场景记忆的检索和玩家可见性判断。

paragraphs.en: State model architecture. As shown in Fig. 3 right, a convolutional encoder maps each latent frame to a token, an action encoder adds the corresponding control embedding, and a causal transformer processes the resulting sequence. A motion head predicts the player’s displacement between consecutive latent frames. A place head provides an absolute position estimate on the current map by classifying the frame into a map cell and predicting its offset within the cell (Appendix A ). A separate depth head predicts a coarse depth map from the generated latents.
paragraphs.zh: 状态模型架构。 如图 3 右侧所示，卷积编码器将每个潜在帧映射为一个标记，动作编码器添加相应的控制嵌入，因果变换器则处理由此生成的序列。 运动头预测玩家在连续潜在帧之间的位移。 位置头通过将帧分类到地图单元格并预测其在该单元格内的偏移量，从而提供当前地图上的绝对位置估计（附录 A）。 一个独立的深度头从生成的潜在数据中预测粗略的深度图。

sents.en: State model architecture.
sents.zh: 状态模型架构。

sents.en: We combine their estimates with a complementary filter:

paragraphs.en: where 𝐩 f \mathbf{p}_{f} is the position estimate at latent frame f f , 𝚫 f \bm{\Delta}_{f} is the motion-head displacement, and 𝐀 f \mathbf{A}_{f} is the place-head estimate, which is the offset to start at the given initial position 𝐩 0 \mathbf{p}_{0} . After each completed block, the client publishes the position estimates, together with its other attributes, as the updated player state. Before generating the next block, each client extrapolates its camera poses and other players’ positions from their latest published player states by integrating movement and view controls, as networked games do between server updates ( Bernier, 2001 ) . These predictions guide player state field construction and scene memory retrieval. Since extrapolation ignores collisions and terrain height, it may diverge from the motion depicted in the generated video. Therefore, once the block is complete, the state model uses the new frames and Eq. ( 4 ) to correct the client’s own position for the next state update.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，𝐩 f \mathbf{p}_{f} 是潜在帧 f f 的位置估计值，𝚫 f \bm{\Delta}_{f} 是运动-头部位移，而 𝐀 f \mathbf{A}_{f} 是位置-头部估计值，即从给定的初始位置 𝐩 0 \mathbf{p}_{0} 开始的偏移量。每个区块完成后，客户端会发布其位置估计值以及其他属性，作为更新后的玩家状态。在生成下一个区块之前，每个客户端都会通过整合移动和视角控制，从其最新发布的玩家状态中推演自身的相机姿态和其他玩家的位置，这与网络游戏中服务器更新之间的处理方式相同（Bernier, 2001）。这些预测将指导玩家状态字段的构建和场景记忆的检索。由于推演过程忽略了碰撞和地形高度，因此可能与生成的视频中呈现的运动存在偏差。所以，一旦区块完成，状态模型便会利用新的帧和公式 (4) 来修正客户端自身的位置，以便进行下一次状态更新。

paragraphs.en: Depth and visibility. The predicted depth maps and camera poses back-project generated observations into 3D points in a common map coordinate system. These points support both scene memory retrieval (Sec. 3.3 ) and visibility gating for the player state field (Sec. 3.2 ). Before generation, the client projects points from its recent context into the cameras of the upcoming block. Their depths determine whether other players are occluded: a player is considered visible when context points reach its projection and their depth lies no more than a fixed margin in front of it (Appendix F ). Since the context may not cover newly exposed regions, the depth head processes the clean estimate 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0} after the first denoising step. This depth updates visibility for the remaining steps.
paragraphs.zh: 深度与可见性。 预测的深度图和相机姿态将生成的观测数据反向投影到公共地图坐标系中的三维点。 这些点既支持场景记忆检索（第 3.3 节），也支持玩家状态场的可见性筛选（第 3.2 节）。 在生成之前，客户端会将其近期上下文中的点投影到即将处理的区块的相机中。 这些点的深度决定了其他玩家是否被遮挡：当上下文点到达玩家的投影位置，且其深度不超过该投影位置前方一个固定范围时，该玩家被视为可见（附录 F）。 由于上下文可能未覆盖新暴露的区域，深度头会在第一次去噪步骤之后处理干净的估计值 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}。 此深度将更新后续步骤中的可见性信息。

paragraphs.en: Training stages. We train G θ G_{\theta} in four stages (Appendix Fig. 8 ). Stage 1 fine-tunes a pretrained video diffusion model on Counter-Strike 2 with bidirectional attention on short clips. Stage 2 conditions G θ G_{\theta} on the shared world state, adding the player state field, then scene state. Player states are GT states taken from recorded matches, and visibility labels are computed from the game’s public 3D map assets. Memory frames are GT frames of one block from another player’s view in the same round, selected to cover what the recent context misses (Appendix E ). Stages 3 and 4 make generation real-time: stage 3 converts G θ G_{\theta} to block-causal attention ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) through teacher forcing, and stage 4 distills it to a four-step generator by distribution matching ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) , trained on its own rollouts to reduce accumulated error ( Huang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 训练阶段。 我们在四个阶段中训练 G θ G_{\theta}（附录图 8）。 第一阶段在《反恐精英 2》上对预训练的 видео扩散模型进行微调，使用双向注意力处理短片段。 第二阶段将 G θ G_{\theta} 条件于共享的世界状态，并添加玩家状态字段，然后是场景状态。 玩家状态是从记录的对局中获取的 GT 状态，而可见性标签则根据游戏的公开 3D 地图资产计算得出。 记忆帧是同一回合中其他玩家视角下相邻一个区块的 GT 帧，选择这些帧以覆盖近期上下文缺失的信息（附录 E）。 第三和第四阶段使生成过程实现实时化：第三阶段通过教师强制将 G θ G_{\theta} 转换为区块因果注意力（Chen et al., 2024; Yin et al., 2025），第四阶段则通过分布匹配将其蒸馏为四步生成器（Yin et al., 2024a; Yin et al., 2024b），并在其自身的 rollout 上进行训练以减少累积误差（Huang et al., 2025b）。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. On four Counter-Strike 2 maps of OpenCS2 ( Blanchon, 2026 ) , split by match into 303 training and 40 held-out matches, we evaluate on 256 ten-second windows and on 32 whole rounds generated concurrently by three clients of one team (five in Table 4 a), the other players following the recording. Unless marked as predicted, methods receive GT player positions from the recording and visibility from map geometry, so that errors of the state model do not confound the comparison.

paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report FVD , PSNR , SSIM , and LPIPS for video quality. Using YOLO11 ( Jocher & Qiu, 2024 ) , Rendered (the rendering rate) measures the fraction of visible players detected in the recording that are rendered within one body width of their state-specified positions. Unmatched measures the fraction of generated detections without a nearby match to a visible player or a recorded detection. Both are medians over views of ten-second windows (Appendix D ). Whole-round rollouts drift from the recording, so we measure consistency between two clients with overlapping views at the same time (Appendix E ). Mat. Pix. ( Bai et al., 2025 ) counts pixels matched by GIM ( Shen et al., 2024 ) . Inliers counts LoFTR ( Sun et al., 2021 ) matches consistent with one relative pose, and RotErr ( He et al., 2025a ) is its rotation error. Depth is the fraction of pixels where both clients’ predicted depths agree. VBench measures visual quality over hour-long rollouts.

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional Model Results and Comparisons. We compare against Solaris ( Savva et al., 2026 ) , which uses joint cross-view attention, and frame concatenation. For a controlled comparison, we retrain both with the same backbone, training data, budget, and GT player positions. Our bidirectional model uses only shared player state in this comparison. As shown in Table 2 , WorldCast outperforms both baselines across all reported metrics. Its player rendering rate reaches 0.817, compared with 0.056 for Solaris and 0.074 for frame concatenation, while its unmatched rate falls to 0.039. These gains demonstrate more accurate player placement alongside improved video quality (also shown in Fig. 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Closed-Loop Deployment. Closed-loop deployment gives each client only its recorded first frame and position (Fig. 7 ). After each block, it publishes its estimated position, renders other players at their published positions, and adds the block to the scene state. The scene state keeps clients more consistent with each other than with it off at inference: all four agreement measures improve (Table 4 a). In one-hour rollouts, VBench scores change little (Table 4 b). With one GPU per player, each client exceeds 16 FPS for 2 to 16 players and receives only the others’ player states and memory entries (a few Mb/s), while Gamma-World ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and Solaris, smaller and hosting all players on one GPU as released, fall below 16 FPS from two players (Fig. 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 闭环部署。 闭环部署仅向每个客户端提供其记录的首帧和位置（图 7）。 每个区块结束后，它会发布其估计位置，在其他玩家已发布的位置上渲染他们，并将该区块添加到场景状态中。 与推理时脱离状态相比，场景状态能让客户端之间的一致性更高：所有四项一致性指标均有改善（表 4a）。 在一小时的运行测试中，VBench 得分变化很小（表 4b）。 每个玩家配备一块 GPU 的情况下，当玩家数量为 2 到 16 名时，每个客户端的帧率均超过 16 FPS，且仅接收其他玩家的状态和内存条目（几 Mb/s）；而 Gamma-World（Liu et al., 2026）和 Solaris——后者规模更小，且根据发布版本将所有玩家部署在单块 GPU 上——从两名玩家开始帧率就低于 16 FPS（图 6）。

paragraphs.en: WorldCast explores a world model as the engine of a networked game, in which each client generates one player’s view on its own GPU and clients exchange only the shared world state. Our method attains a player rendering rate over an order of magnitude higher than joint generation, and scene state improves whole-round consistency. The main limitation is the state model’s position error on generated video, which grows with time (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: WorldCast 将世界模型用作联网游戏的引擎，其中每个客户端都在自己的 GPU 上生成一名玩家的视角，而客户端之间仅交换共享的世界状态。 我们的方法实现的玩家渲染速率比联合生成高一个数量级，并且场景状态的全轮一致性也得到了提升。 主要局限性是状态模型在生成的视频中的位置误差会随时间增长（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the appendix, GT states are the recorded player states, whose positions are the GT player positions of Sec. 4 , with visibility from the map geometry; predicted states replace these positions and the visibility with those predicted by the state model.

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the state model of Sec. 3.4 . Its motion head predicts the player’s displacement between consecutive latent frames, its place head recognizes where on the map a frame was taken, and the complementary filter of Eq. ( 4 ) advances one estimate by the former and corrects it with the latter.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了第 3.4 节中的状态模型。其运动头预测玩家在连续潜在帧之间的位移，其位置头识别出某一帧在地图上的拍摄位置，而公式 (4) 中的互补滤波器则利用前者推进一个估计值，并利用后者对其进行修正。

paragraphs.en: The state model reads windows of 41 noise-free latent frames ( 48 × 24 × 42 48\times 24\times 42 ) of the client’s own video; one latent frame spans four video frames at 16 fps, or sixteen engine ticks. Five convolutional blocks (three strided) map each latent frame from 48 to 512 channels, and a linear projection yields a token of width 1280. A causal transformer trunk (16 layers, 16 heads, pre-norm, 4 × 4\times feed-forward) processes these tokens, and a linear motion head on its outputs predicts the three-dimensional displacement. The sixteen control values per tick (thirteen buttons, pitch and yaw deltas, a validity flag) are projected to 256 dimensions, encoded by the action encoder (a four-layer causal transformer) and added to the trunk tokens. The place head takes detached trunk tokens, a pooled early feature map, and the unpooled 12 × 21 12\times 21 grid, concatenates a map embedding, and outputs an address (below). The trunk and action encoder have 338 338 M parameters and the motion and place heads 11 11 M.
paragraphs.zh: 状态模型读取客户端自身视频中长度为 41 个无噪声潜在帧（48 × 24 × 42）的窗口；一个潜在帧对应 16 fps 下的四帧视频，即十六个引擎计时步。 五个卷积块（其中三个为步长卷积）将每个潜在帧的通道数从 48 映射到 512，并通过线性投影生成宽度为 1280 的令牌。 一个因果变换器主干网络（16 层、16 个头、预归一化、4 × 4 前馈网络）处理这些令牌，其输出上的线性运动头预测三维位移。 每个计时步的十六个控制值（十三个按钮、音高和偏航增量以及一个有效性标志）被投影到 256 维空间，由动作编码器（一个四层因果变换器）编码后与主干网络的令牌相加。 位置头使用分离的主干网络令牌、池化后的早期特征图以及未池化的 12 × 21 网格，拼接一个地图嵌入，并输出一个地址（见下文）。 主干网络和动作编码器共有 338 M 个参数，而运动和位置头各有 11 M 个参数。

paragraphs.en: As in networked games, each client extrapolates the motion of all players locally and is authoritative for its own player. The cameras of a block’s four latent frames and the other players’ positions over it are extrapolated from the controls ( Bernier, 2001 ) , since the block has no frames yet. Clients exchange player state once per block (Sec. 3.1 ); with predicted states, block n n starts from the positions published when it begins, each player’s estimate at the last latent frame of block n − 1 n-1 . Each player’s movement keys are integrated at 64 Hz with per-key walking speeds, without collisions, and the facing direction accumulates the view controls from the last known facing direction. After the block, each client corrects only its own player’s position, with the state model and Eq. ( 4 ) on its new frames, and publishes it; every client then extrapolates over the next block from these corrected positions. With GT states, the GT cameras and positions are used.
paragraphs.zh: 与网络游戏中的情况一样，每个客户端都在本地外推所有玩家的运动，并对自身玩家拥有权威控制权。一个区块中四个潜在帧的摄像头以及其他玩家在该区块上的位置，是根据控制输入进行外推的（Bernier, 2001），因为此时该区块尚未生成任何帧。客户端在每个区块中仅交换一次玩家状态（第 3.1 节）；借助预测状态，区块 n n 从其开始时所发布的位置起步，即每个玩家在区块 n − 1 n-1 的最后一个潜在帧中的估计位置。每个玩家的移动按键以 64 Hz 的频率进行积分，并采用各按键对应的行走速度，期间不发生碰撞；而面向方向则基于上一次已知的面向方向，累积视口控制信息。区块结束后，每个客户端仅修正自身玩家的位置，利用状态模型和公式（4）处理其新帧数据，并将其发布；随后，所有客户端都基于这些修正后的位置，对下一个区块进行外推。若使用 GT 状态，则采用 GT 摄像头和位置数据。

paragraphs.en: All components are trained on rounds disjoint from both evaluation sets, with AdamW, a one-cycle schedule, and weight decay 0.01 0.01 . The trunk and action encoder are trained with an L 1 L_{1} displacement loss for 80,000 steps at batch 16 (about four hours of training) on 150 150 k windows from 8,317 rounds; the place head is then trained on the same windows, with the trunk frozen, for 60,000 steps at batch 16, both at a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} . paragraphs.en: Table 6 compares the state model with extrapolation from the controls, which networked games use between server updates ( Bernier, 2001 ) , and isolates its motion and place heads. The place head anchors the global position, height included. On recorded video the state model keeps the median error near 0.5 0.5 body widths over the minute, with 87 % 87\% of clients within two body widths at 60 60 s, whereas extrapolation drifts to 7.6 7.6 and leaves 2 % 2\% ; it does not know the height of the ground either, erring in height by a median of 3.4 3.4 body widths over the minute against 0.06 0.06 for the state model. On video generated with GT states, the state model’s error, which includes each rollout’s departure from the GT trajectory, grows to 2.6 2.6 at 50 50 – 60 60 s, a third of that of extrapolation. The motion head reads local motion from the frames, such as a stop against a wall: in the Blocked windows it misplaces the one-second displacement by 0.05 0.05 body widths on recorded and 0.38 0.38 on generated video, against 2.38 2.38 and 2.42 2.42 for extrapolation, although alone it drifts, to 2.0 2.0 and 22.7 22.7 at 50 50 – 60 60 s. Eq. ( 4 ) combines the two. Over the minute it is on par with the place head alone, which is slightly ahead on generated video ( 2.51 2.51 against 2.64 2.64 body widths at 50 50 – 60 60 s); per latent frame, the step at which the complementary filter and the player state field are updated, its displacement error is about half that of the place head alone on recorded video, 0.21 0.21 against 0.45 0.45 body widths, and a third lower on generated video, 0.45 0.45 against 0.69 0.69 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 将状态模型与基于控制器的外推法进行了比较——网络游戏在服务器更新之间使用这种外推法（Bernier, 2001）——并分别分析了其运动和位置头部的表现。 位置头负责锚定全局位置，包括高度信息。 在录制视频中，状态模型在一分钟内将中位误差保持在约 0.5 个身体宽度附近，60 秒时 87% 的客户端误差在两个身体宽度以内；而外推法则会漂移至 7.6，且 2% 的客户端误差超出范围。此外，外推法也无法感知地面高度，其高度中位误差在一分钟内达到 3.4 个身体宽度，而状态模型仅为 0.06。 在通过 GT 状态生成的视频中，状态模型的误差（包括每次展开与 GT 轨迹的偏离）在 50–60 秒时增长至 2.6，仅为外推法误差的三分之一。 运动头从帧中读取局部运动信息，例如面对墙壁时的停止动作：在“Blocked windows”场景中，它在录制视频中将一秒内的位移误判了 0.05 个身体宽度，在生成视频中则误判了 0.38；而外推法的误差分别为 2.38 和 2.42。不过，单独使用时，运动头会产生漂移，在 50–60 秒时分别达到 2.0 和 22.7。公式 (4) 将两者结合使用。 在一分钟的整体表现上，该模型与单独使用的位置头相当，在生成视频中略胜一筹（50–60 秒时分别为 2.51 和 2.64 个身体宽度）；以每个潜在帧（即互补滤波器和玩家状态场更新的时间步长）计算，其在录制视频中的位移误差约为单独使用位置头的一半（0.21 对比 0.45 个身体宽度），在生成视频中则低三分之一（0.45 对比 0.69）。

paragraphs.en: Every client, once per block, publishes one message and reads the latest message of every other client, without a central process that merges them. For block n n , client j j (i) publishes its player state 𝐬 n j \mathbf{s}^{j}_{n} , that is, the positions that Eq. ( 4 ) estimates at the four latent frames of block n − 1 n-1 , the facing direction, and the controls and weapon for block n n ; with scene state, also block n − 1 n-1 as a memory entry (four cameras and depths) and the memory entries it withdraws; and (ii) generates block n n : it extrapolates the other players from their latest player states over the block (Appendix A ), applies the withdrawals and retrieves at most one memory entry completed before block n n , whose latents it fetches from the client that generated it. A message takes 3.7 3.7 kB for the player state and 8.3 8.3 kB for a memory entry (cameras in single precision, a 4 × 24 × 42 4\times 24\times 42 depth in half precision); fetching the latents of a memory entry takes 387 387 kB. With GT states, player states come from the recording, and messages carry only the scene state. In our evaluations, each client runs on its own GPU, messages and latents are exchanged through a shared file system (for the timings of Table 7 with P ≤ 8 P\leq 8 , through shared memory on one machine), and the clients advance in lockstep, so that every client reads the messages of the same block.
paragraphs.zh: 每个客户端在每个区块中仅发布一条消息，并读取其他所有客户端的最新消息，而无需中央进程对这些消息进行合并。对于第 n 个区块，客户端 j（i）会执行以下操作：(i) 发布其玩家状态 𝐬 n j \mathbf{s}^{j}_{n}，即方程 (4) 在第 n−1 个区块的四个潜在帧中估计出的位置、朝向方向，以及第 n 个区块的控制输入和武器；同时还会包含场景状态，其中第 n−1 个区块作为记忆条目（包括四个摄像头和深度数据），以及它提取的记忆条目；(ii) 生成第 n 个区块：根据其他玩家的最新玩家状态，在整个区块内对其状态进行外推（见附录 A），应用提取操作，并最多检索一个在第 n 个区块之前完成生成的记忆条目，其潜在数据则从生成该条目的客户端获取。一条消息中，玩家状态占用 3.7 kB，记忆条目（单精度摄像头、4×24×42 的半精度深度数据）占用 8.3 kB；而检索一个记忆条目的潜在数据则需要 387 kB。在使用真实游戏状态（GT states）时，玩家状态来自录制数据，消息中仅包含场景状态。在我们的评估中，每个客户端都在自己的 GPU 上运行，消息和潜在数据通过共享文件系统交换（对于表 7 中 P ≤ 8 的情况，则通过单台机器上的共享内存交换），且所有客户端同步推进，因此每个客户端都会读取同一区块的消息。

paragraphs.en: In Solaris , each player attends to the windows of all players in one joint attention; frame concatenation attends over the same tokens with the players’ frames interleaved in time; Gamma-World’s sparse hub adds eight hub tokens per frame that attend to every player, while each player attends to its own window and the hubs. As released, Solaris and Gamma-World generate every player’s view on one GPU, and we time them unchanged, all players on one GPU; frame concatenation is retrained only with our backbone (Appendix C ) and is not timed. Joint attention reads the keys and values of all players at every layer, so, placed one player per GPU, they would exchange keys and values at every layer of every denoising step (Table 7 ). WorldCast places each player on its own GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Solaris 中，每个智能体都会对所有智能体的窗口进行联合注意力处理；帧拼接则在同一令牌上进行注意力处理，且各智能体的帧在时间上交错排列；Gamma-World 的稀疏枢纽每帧添加八个枢纽令牌，这些令牌会对每个智能体进行注意力处理，而每个智能体则仅对其自身的窗口和枢纽进行注意力处理。 在已发布的版本中，Solaris 和 Gamma-World 会在单个 GPU 上生成每个智能体的视图，并且我们在测试时未对此部分进行修改，所有智能体均运行于单个 GPU 上；帧拼接仅使用我们的主干网络（附录 C）重新训练，并未进行计时。 联合注意力会在每一层读取所有智能体的键和值，因此，若每个 GPU 仅分配一个智能体，它们将在每次去噪步骤的每一层交换键和值（表 7）。 WorldCast 将每个智能体部署在独立的 GPU 上。

paragraphs.en: Because the attention window is bounded, a client’s time per block and GPU memory footprint do not keep growing with the length of a stream. Over a three-minute stream of a single client with scene state and CUDA graphs, a block whose window holds memory frames takes 633 ms in the first minute and 654 and 650 ms in the second and third, the increase being mostly the writes to the memory bank once the pool of the client’s own memory entries is full; the footprint grows once, by 0.9 0.9 GiB, when a CUDA graph is captured for the first window without memory frames, and not afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 由于注意力窗口是有限的，因此单个客户端处理每个区块所需的时间以及 GPU 内存占用量不会随着流长度的增加而持续增长。 在一个持续三分钟的、包含场景状态和 CUDA 图的单客户端流中，其窗口内存储了内存帧的某个区块在第一分钟需要 633 毫秒，在第二和第三分钟分别需要 654 毫秒和 650 毫秒；这种增长主要源于客户端自身内存条目池满后对内存银行的写入操作；当第一个窗口在没有内存帧的情况下首次捕获 CUDA 图时，内存占用量会一次性增加 0.9 GiB，之后则不再增长。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4 runs 600 steps at a global batch of 64 ten-second windows, updating the generator every fifth step and the critic otherwise. The generator is initialized from the stage-3 model, and the teacher and critic from WorldCast , the stage-2 model at 25,000 steps (Table 2 ), which has no scene state. From the recorded first frame, the generator produces the other 40 latent frames of each window as ten blocks of four, each conditioned on its own earlier outputs; the teacher and critic score the whole window bidirectionally. Distillation windows contain no memory frames, yet the four-step model retains the use of memory frames learned in stages 2 and 3 (Appendix E ): after 30 s, WorldCast exceeds the same weights with scene state off at inference by 1.23 1.23 dB PSNR [ 0.91 , 1.55 ] [0.91,1.55] (Table 18 ).

paragraphs.en: The two baselines keep jointly generated views consistent through attention between them; they receive the player states as tokens, in training and at inference, so that they know where the other players are, as the field does; the comparison is between joint generation and the player state field, not between ways of feeding states. Each player’s state enters as one token per latent frame, with the token contents of the model trained without camera alignment (Appendix F ) and the GT visibility label, folded per latent frame as for the field. The tokens join the cross-attention context, their mean over players is added to the frame’s action modulation, and training uses the uniform loss.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种基线方法通过彼此之间的注意力机制，保持联合生成的视图具有一致性；在训练和推理阶段，它们都将玩家状态作为令牌接收，从而能够像场域一样了解其他玩家的位置；比较的对象是联合生成与玩家状态场域，而非状态输入方式。 每位玩家的状态以每个潜在帧一个令牌的形式输入，其中模型未经相机对齐训练的令牌内容（附录 F）以及 GT 可见性标签，均按潜在帧进行折叠处理，如同场域一样。 这些令牌会加入交叉注意力上下文，其跨玩家的均值会被添加到帧的动作调制中，而训练过程则使用均匀损失函数。

sents.en: Each player’s state enters as one token per latent frame, with the token contents of the model trained without camera alignment (Appendix F ) and the GT visibility label, folded per latent frame as for the field.
sents.zh: 每位玩家的状态以每个潜在帧一个令牌的形式输入，其中模型未经相机对齐训练的令牌内容（附录 F）以及 GT 可见性标签，均按潜在帧进行折叠处理，如同场域一样。

sents.en: The tokens join the cross-attention context, their mean over players is added to the frame’s action modulation, and training uses the uniform loss.
sents.zh: 这些令牌会加入交叉注意力上下文，其跨玩家的均值会被添加到帧的动作调制中，而训练过程则使用均匀损失函数。

paragraphs.en: Every model that receives the states as tokens, coupled or not, renders below 0.1 0.1 , against 0.763 0.763 for WorldCast at the same 384k windows: the model trained without camera alignment (Table 5 ), a single view given the states as tokens, renders 0.093 0.093 , against 0.074 0.074 for frame concatenation and 0.056 0.056 for Solaris at 1.6M windows (Table 2 ). paragraphs.en: Both sets are drawn from the 1,373 rounds of the 40 held-out matches by rules fixed before any reported result and based only on the recordings and the map assets: the visibility labels computed from them, which players’ first-person views the dataset holds, and the length of each recording. The set of ten-second windows takes 64 rounds per map, 256 in total, in a seeded random order and, in each, the ten-second window, among windows starting every 2.5 s, and the pair of players with a first-person view of it that maximize the smaller of the two shares of frames in which one player has the other in view. These two players give the two generated views, the pair that the joint-generation methods generate together; this smaller share ranges from 16% to 100% (median 48%), and windows start a median of 23 s into the round. The whole-round set scores each group of three players whose recordings all last at least 60 s by the share of seconds in which one player has another in view in at least half of the frames, averaged over its two pairs with the highest shares and multiplied by the rollout length capped at 120 s; it keeps the eight rounds per map with the best-scoring groups. Although the rule does not require one team, in all 32 rounds the three selected players are teammates who remain alive throughout their rollouts, which run from the round start to the end of the shortest recording (67 to 120 s). All methods and ablations use the same windows and rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 这两组数据均源自 40 场预留比赛中 1,373 个回合，其规则在报告任何结果之前就已确定，且仅基于录像和地图资源：即由此计算出的可见性标签（数据集包含玩家的第一人称视角）、以及每个录像的长度。 十秒窗口组针对每张地图选取 64 个回合，总计 256 个回合，按种子随机顺序排列；在每个回合中，从每 2.5 秒开始的所有窗口中，选择一对拥有该窗口第一人称视角的玩家，使得其中一名玩家视野中能看到另一名玩家的帧数占比中的较小值最大化。 这对玩家生成两个视角，即联合生成方法共同生成的视角对；该较小帧数占比的范围为 16% 至 100%（中位数为 48%），且窗口的起始时间中位数为回合开始后的 23 秒。 整轮数据组根据每组三名玩家的录像进行评分：这些录像的时长均至少为 60 秒；评分依据是，在至少一半的帧中，一名玩家视野中能看到另一名玩家的秒数占比，再对该玩家与另外两名玩家组成的两个组合中占比最高的两个值取平均，并乘以最多为 120 秒的展开长度；最终保留每张地图得分最高的八个回合。 尽管规则并未要求必须组成一支队伍，但在全部 32 个回合中，选出的三名玩家均为队友，且在整个展开过程中保持存活；展开过程从回合开始持续至最短录像结束（67 至 120 秒）。 所有方法和消融实验均使用相同的窗口和回合。

paragraphs.en: Rendered and Unmatched are computed in all tables with the rule of Sec. 4 , against the state given to the generator (with GT states, the recorded position and the visibility computed from the map assets). A pair of another player and a frame is scored if the player is marked visible in the state given to the generator, the player’s box clipped to the 384 × 672 384\times 672 frame covers at least 24 2 24^{2} pixels, and the detector finds the player in the recorded video; the player is rendered if a person is detected within one body width, the width of the player’s projected box, of its position in the given player state, each detected person matching at most one player. A detected person is unmatched if neither a player marked visible in the given state, with a projected box at least 24 pixels on its short side, nor a person detected in the recorded video lies within one body width of it; the unmatched rate is the unmatched share of persons detected in the generated frames. Both rates are computed for each view, one player’s view of a ten-second window, with a whole round split into consecutive ten-second windows, and are summarized by their median over the views with at least eight pairs or eight detected persons, respectively; the views in the unmatched median thus depend on how many persons a generator draws and can differ between rows. paragraphs.zh: 在所有表格中，根据第 4 节的规则，针对提供给生成器的状态（包括 GT 状态、记录的位置以及从地图资产计算出的可见性），计算出已渲染和未匹配的智能体。 如果玩家在提供给生成器的状态中被标记为可见，且玩家边界框裁剪到 384 × 672 的帧中至少覆盖 24² 个像素，同时检测器在记录的视频中找到该玩家，则对该玩家与某一帧的组合进行计分；若在给定玩家状态中的位置处检测到一名人物，且其距离不超过一个身体宽度（即玩家投影边界框的宽度），并且每个检测到的人物最多匹配一个玩家，则该玩家被视为已渲染。 如果既没有给定状态中被标记为可见且短边投影边界框至少为 24 像素的玩家，也没有记录视频中被检测到的人物位于该检测人物的一个身体宽度范围内，则此检测人物被视为未匹配；未匹配率是生成帧中检测到的人物中未匹配的比例。 每个视角（即一名玩家在十秒窗口内的视角）都会计算这两种比率，其中整个回合被划分为连续的十秒窗口；然后分别对至少有八个配对或八个检测人物的视角取这些比率的中间值进行汇总；因此，未匹配率中间值所对应的视角取决于生成器抽取的人物数量，并可能在不同行之间有所差异。 表 16 则对每个拥挤程度级别的已计分配对进行了汇总。

paragraphs.en: Since each rollout departs from the recording, the scene state is also evaluated by the consistency among clients within the world they generate. Mat. Pix. counts the pixels that GIM ( Shen et al., 2024 ) matches between two clients’ frames at the same instant with confidence above 0.05, as in SynCamMaster ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Inliers counts the LoFTR ( Sun et al., 2021 ) matches between the two frames that fit one essential matrix, estimated with MAGSAC++ ( Barath et al., 2020 ) , and RotErr, as in CameraCtrl ( He et al., 2025a ) and SynCamMaster, is the angle between the rotation recovered from that matrix and the relative rotation of the two cameras. All three are computed over the pairs of clients whose views are co-visible in the recording. On the recorded video of the pairs scored in Table 4 a, same-instant pairs score far better than pairs offset by 10 s (Mat. Pix. 163.1 163.1 K against 52.3 52.3 K, Inliers 128.3 128.3 against 36.4 36.4 , RotErr 16.7 ∘ 16.7^{\circ} against 64.9 ∘ 64.9^{\circ} ; better in all but two rounds for Mat. Pix. and in every round for the others), so the measures track agreement between views. To test whether the clients of a round generate the same scene, Table 19 compares the depths that two clients predict for their generated frames at the same instant. The depth that the depth head predicts for one client’s latent frame is back-projected with that client’s camera and reprojected into the other client’s camera; a pixel agrees if the reprojected depth and the other client’s own depth there lie within the larger of 24 24 u and 5 % 5\% . The share of agreeing pixels is averaged over the same pairs and over the rounds. The recorded video gives the upper bound, and a client’s depth from 10 s later, placed at its current camera, the chance level. The scene state raises this agreement, particularly after 30 s, and every ablation falls below WorldCast . It leaves each client’s agreement with its own next latent frame unchanged, so the gain does not come from a steadier depth estimate. In the closed-loop deployment of Table 4 a, where the clients use predicted states and each client’s depth is reprojected with the cameras it publishes, the scene state likewise raises the agreement after 30 s, from 0.092 0.092 to 0.120 0.120 , and leaves it unchanged in the first 30 s. paragraphs.en: All clients share one scene state per round. A memory entry is one block (four latent frames, one second of video), stored with each latent frame’s camera and the depth predicted by the depth head from the block’s own latents, one value per 16 × 16 16\times 16 -pixel patch (Sec. 3.4 ). Each latent frame spans four video frames and takes the camera and depth of the last, when its content is complete and the state model reads its position. A set of memory entries covers a pixel of a frame if the nearest of their reprojected points matches the frame’s depth there within the larger of 24 24 u and 5 % 5\% . Every generated block is published as a memory entry; each client keeps at most B = 64 B=64 of its own, withdrawing beyond this bound the one best covered by its others (the older on a tie). With reprojections between a client’s memory entries cached, publishing adds at most 2 ​ B 2B reprojections and withdrawal requires none. The scene state thus holds at most B B memory entries per client for any rollout length, and B ​ P BP for P P clients. Retrieval projects every memory entry completed before a block, so its per-block cost grows with the number of memory entries, at most linearly in P P , unlike the generator’s; the frame rates of Table 7 include it.

paragraphs.en: The field has twenty-three channels on the model’s token grid, 12 × 21 12\times 21 per latent frame (the 24 × 42 24\times 42 latent grid of a 384 × 672 384\times 672 frame, patchified by two): coverage; log-compressed depth; the sine and cosine of the yaw relative to the observer; team; headcount; nine control channels, each the fraction of the latent frame during which a key is held (forward, back, strafe left, strafe right, jump, crouch, walk, attack, reload); four weapon-embedding channels; dying and corpse channels, written where the player fell; and two identity channels.
paragraphs.zh: 该字段在模型的标记网格上拥有二十三个通道：每个潜在帧包含 12 × 21 个单元（即 384 × 672 帧的 24 × 42 潜在网格经两两分块后的结果）；覆盖范围；对数压缩深度；相对于观察者的偏航角的正弦和余弦值；队伍；人数；九个控制通道，每个通道表示在潜在帧中某个按键被持续按下的比例（前进、后退、向左移动、向右移动、跳跃、蹲下、行走、攻击、重新装弹）；四个武器嵌入通道；死亡与尸体通道，记录玩家倒下的位置；以及两个身份通道。

paragraphs.en: In our evaluations, clients advance in lockstep, one block at a time (Sec. 3.1 ); the evaluations and timing measurements (Appendix B ) vary neither network delay, jitter nor loss, and do not study clients that fall behind. Within a block, a client extrapolates the other players’ latest published positions from their controls (Appendix A ); the effect of staleness on rendering is not measured. Player states and memory entries from other clients are used as received, without cross-checking, so a faulty client alters what the others render.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的评估中，客户端同步推进，每次仅前进一个区块（第 3.1 节）；这些评估和计时测量（附录 B）既不改变网络延迟、抖动或丢包率，也未研究落后的客户端。 在一个区块内，客户端根据其他玩家的控制信息推断出其最新发布的坐标（附录 A）；陈旧数据对渲染的影响并未被测量。 来自其他客户端的玩家状态和内存条目会直接按接收到的形式使用，而无需交叉验证，因此一个故障客户端会改变其他客户端的渲染结果。

paragraphs.en: Every client starts from recorded first frames and its GT position (Appendices A and D ). In the whole rounds, three players of one team run clients, and all five in Table 4 a, while the other players follow their GT states; in Table 2 , players without a recorded first-person view of the window keep their recorded states; each one-hour rollout follows one player’s recorded controls and restarts its position estimate at that player’s recorded spawn position in every round (Appendix D ).
